Contact

pro.ayizih@gmail.com

MILAN - MUNICH - PARIS 



My name is Hiziya Ribery, a 20-year old French–Arab creative. 

I grew up surrounded by multiple cultures, which gave me an expanded perspective on the world. I have been passionate about fashion and 
visual arts from a very young age, and my goal is to build a life and career entirely from this passion.


Versatile person I can understand different perspectives and adapt to many environments. I have an open mind, and I’m able to follow and connect with a wide range of ideas and creative directions. 

That’s why fashion and visual art  resonate so strongly with me: each has its own themes and language, yet they all exist within the same artistic universe.
